grammar-de-propn-dev-person-peters-gen.explanation: The prompt and a distinct Hans demonstration explicitly teach articleless genitive suffix stripping; the model treated Peters as a nominative surname despite the possessive construction.

grammar-de-propn-dev-product-adidas.explanation: The sentence provides no reliable grammatical-gender agreement and the prompt requires null rather than shape-based inference; the model invented Neut.

grammar-de-propn-dev-work-prozess.explanation: The prompt explicitly assigns quoted-title mentions without contextual name case to Citation; the model borrowed accusative from the surrounding common noun Titel.

grammar-de-propn-dev-transliteration-kyj.explanation: The oracle called Kyjiw Variant while also making Kyjiw the canonicalForm and gave no alternative identity relation; this should be Canonical.

grammar-de-propn-dev-variant-pressburg.explanation: The original sentence merely mentioned Pressburg in a historical report and did not establish that it was an archaic exonym of Bratislava; the asserted Variant/Lemma relation lacked input evidence.

grammar-de-propn-dev-casing-berLin.explanation: The model repaired casing correctly but assigned dative after directional nach; the prompt requires case from syntax and the motion destination is accusative.
